name: Olive Garden Herb-Grilled Salmon (Plain, Garlic Butter Withheld)
searchKeywords: herb grilled salmon no garlic butter
whyItWorks: Filet of salmon grilled tender. Naturally rich in marine omega-3 fatty acids. By withholding the heavy garlic herb butter sauce, it becomes an exceptionally gentle, safe Italian dining entree.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Herb-Grilled Salmon completely plain—NO garlic butter, NO marinara, NO seasoning blend, grilled with salt only.' Request plain steamed broccoli (eat florets only) or plain pasta with olive oil.
